rationale:
Independent judgment: APPROVE. This is an installer-only amendment (exactly 3 files per RAW_DIFF_STATS: a new preflight test, the installer, and one runtime constant), layered on the genuine prior APPROVE79d3 of the full connector at source 81916032. All other 44 source files carry hashes identical to the prior packet-manifest, so the prior approval's coverage of the unchanged budget/GPU/scientific/provider/worker paths is reused at its scope.

State-parent correction is equivalent-or-stronger, not a weakening. The old check required the inventory at uid=1003/mode=0700 and then trusted()-ed the service-owned container for root ownership, which contradicts the actual host topology (INSTALL_STATE_PARENT_OBSERVATION and COLD_INSTALL_PARENT.stdout show inventory = root:1003 0750 inside container 1003:1003 0700, root-owned ancestors). INSTALL_SETUP_CONTINUATION.stderr confirms the old code genuinely refused at STATE_PARENT before any target write. The new state_parent() pins the exact path (STATE_PARENT_PATH), requires S_ISDIR, no symlink and exact (uid,gid,mode) at both the inventory (root:1003:0750) and container (1003:1003:0700) levels, and trusted()-es /var/lib and above (root-owned, non-world-writable, no symlinks). It does not chmod/chown/create any existing directory; the preflight test monkeypatches chmod/chown to fail and still passes. Accepting a root-owned 0750 inventory with a service-owned 0700 container is the pre-existing arrangement and confines sibling creation in the inventory to root while the service user (the same partho identity that runs the operation) owns only its own 0700 state; this is a reasonable provider-appropriate confinement, not a new exposure.

Preflight is read-only: install(preflight=True) returns {PREFLIGHT_PASS,0,0,0} at the point just before the first put(); every preceding step is a read-only check or a disposable TemporaryDirectory, and EXISTS_RECONCILE requires all install targets absent with old units inactive (corroborated by COLD_INSTALL_PARENT). No INSTALL_INTENT or target write can occur in preflight.

Execution-authority rebinding is coherent and not weakened. Both the installer (change_id==manifest==item4-diagnostic-native-install-20261010) and the runtime authority() (REVIEW_CHANGE==install-20261010, reading the installed review and matching report_sha256/source_sha/runtime_sha256) now require a genuine independent APPROVE of exactly this packet before any install write or any reservation via item4_diagnostic_native.limit()->authority(). The runtime's path constants remain CHANGE=execution-20261010, so installed locations are unchanged; only the required review identity moves to this amendment. No reservation or compute can precede this approval; both prior install attempts failed pre-write and their failures/charges are preserved (none incurred).

No scientific or live-native result is claimed; cold native/reviewer evidence is explicitly labelled disposable/synthetic. I found no unresolved issue in any fixed category (test-set leakage, code/spec mismatch, metric/statistic, privacy/secret, budget, execution authority/provenance), so findings are empty. Direction: PROCEED with this single bundled corrective review; it is the shortest safe path and adds no unnecessary infrastructure.
